name: vds-x
description: Local AI coding agent — Ollama + ECC (layer B)

vdsx.ollama.host.description: LLM server base URL. OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint expected (llama.cpp, LM Studio, Ollama's OpenAI shim all work).

vdsx.ollama.model.description: Model id exactly as returned by /v1/models.

vdsx.ollama.apiKey.description: Bearer token for the LLM server. Required.

vdsx.ollama.numCtx.description: Advisory only — llama.cpp OpenAI endpoint ignores per-request num_ctx. Server 192.168.1.220 currently runs --ctx-size 49152. 64k tested OOMs on RTX 3060 during large-prompt inference; 48k is the safe ceiling.

vdsx.ollama.maxOutput.description: Max output tokens per LLM response (llama.cpp n_predict). Caps runaway generation; most replies are far shorter.

vdsx.eccPaths.description: Directories to scan for ECC agents/commands/rules. Relative paths are resolved against workspace root.

vdsx.maxIterations.description: Max agent loop iterations per user message.

vdsx.autoApprove.description: Tool names that don't require approval.

vdsx.contextFiles.description: Files loaded from workspace root and injected into the system prompt of every agent call (chat turn, /do phases). Caps at 8KB total.

vdsx.phaseAgents.description: Maps /do orchestrator phases to ECC agent names. Each agent's body is injected as guidance into that phase's system prompt. Set a value to empty string to use the generic built-in prompt.

enumDescriptions: Clear conversation when switching between Chat and Workflow modes (safest, avoids tool messages confusing a chat-mode LLM).
Keep independent conversation per mode — prior messages restored when you switch back.
vdsx.modeHistory.description: How conversation history behaves when you switch between Chat and Workflow modes.

enumDescriptions: Show approval modal for every risky tool call (safest).
Auto-approve edit_file and write_file; still ask for bash.
Read-only: deny write/edit/bash outright. Great for exploring.
Auto-approve all non-bash tools; still ask for bash.
vdsx.defaultPermissionMode.description: Default permission mode for Workflow agent tool calls.

enumDescriptions: Vietnamese — translate final summaries to Vietnamese after LLM responds.
Japanese — translate final summaries to Japanese after LLM responds.
vdsx.outputLanguage.description: Language for user-facing summaries. LLM works internally in English; only final summary is translated.

vdsx.ollama.models.description: Additional models to pick from (via Switch model menu). Each entry overrides ollama.model and optionally host/apiKey for the current session.

vdsx.outputDir.description: Workspace-relative folder for agent-generated artifacts (diffs, tests, reports). Auto-added to .gitignore.
